text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, June 3 - Chittagong - 23 vessels in port of which 5 containers, 4 general cargo, 1 cement clinker, 4 cement, 2 tankers, 1 rapeseed, 1 sugar, 5 repairs. 24 vessels due by 10/6 of which 11 containers, 4 general cargo, 1 foodgrain, 4 tankers, 1 fertiliser, 2 rapeseed, 1 sugar. no berthing delays.

CHINA, June 2 - Keelung - four vessels anchored. Delays coal 6 days, steel, iron ore 3 days. No delays for grain. Kaohsiung - four vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain 2 days, iron/coal 6 days (CSC berth), coal/scrap 7 days (public berth), steel 1 day. Taichung - five vessels anchored. Delays grain 4-5 days, 1 day iron ore, coal, scrap, steel, others.

INDIA, June 3 - Bombay - delays expected for vessels due containers 1-2 days, bulk vessels 6-7 days, general cargo 2-3 days, 7 vessels loading at berth, 20 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 14 to discharge, 3 vessels under repairs, 3 awaiting orders. Gang shortage due to holidays. Calcutta - 30 vessels due of which 2 coking coal, 10 product tankers, 7 containers, 1 crude, 2 coal, 1 wheels/pipes, 1 peas, 1 wood, 2 logs, 2 rock phosphate, 1 pulses 6 vessels loading at berth, 16 discharging at berth, 2 bunkering, 1 under repairs. Cochin - ten vessels due, up to 1 days delay, 1 vessel loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 1 general cargo vessel at csl jetty, 1 naval vessel at drydock. Madras - 35 vessels due - delays expected coal/coke 2-3 days, fertiliser, scrap 5-6 days, 5 vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Mormugao - five ore vessels due, no delays expected, 1 container vessel due, 6-7 days delay, 1 coke

MALAYSIA, June 4 - Port Klang north/south port container/ro/ro berth 6 vessels alongside, 6 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf 4 vessels alongside, 2 berthed, 3 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal 2 vessels alongside, 4 waiting, 3 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal 4 vessels alongside, 7 waiting, 1 days waiting time. west port container/ro/ro berth 2 vessels alongside, no waiting time. deep draft conventional wharf 4 alongside, 4 waiting, 3 days waiting time. Bulk cement terminal 1 vessel alongside, 3 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal 1 vessel alongside, no waiting time.

S.Korea, June 3 - Inchon - 69 vessels in port (46 berthed, 23 anchored) of which 9 logs, 7 general cargo, 4 each steel, containers, 3 each cars, scrap, 2 each rapemeal, ply, 1 each pig iron, cement, talc, stones, tapioca, molasses, wheat pellets, steel plates, soda, maize, wheat, corn. Anchored 7 scrap, 5 logs, 3 containers, 2 general cargo, 1 bananas, corn, steel, cars, cottonmeal, raw sugar, approx. 1 days delay expected. Busan - 157 vessels in port (44 berthed, 113 anchored including 56 laid up) of which 28 general cargo, 7 containers, 5 scrap, 4 coal, 57 vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Pohang - 18 vessels berthed of which discharging 4 scrap, 1 each iron ore, coke, billets, ferrochrome, slabs, logs, pig iron, coils, 6 loading steel, no berthing delays. Ulsan - 24 vessels berthed of which discharging 3 feed meal, 1 each cement, paraxylene, vinyl chloride monomer, base oil, raw sugar, pipes, ethane, zinc concentrate, crude oil, corn, propylene oxide, propane, loading 5 gene

SINGAPORE, June 3 - Tanjong Pagar container terminal 7 vessels berthed, Keppel terminal 9 container/general cargo vessels berthed, Pasir Panjang terminal 15 container/general cargo vessels berthed, Sembawang terminal 3 general cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port 2 bulk cargo/steel/general cargo Vessels berthed, Oil terminals/sbm buoys: 26 Tankers berthed. Minimal berthing delays at all ports/facilities.

SRI LANKA, June 3 - Colombo - vessels due 8 containers/feeders, 1 bundle steel. Delays 24-48 hours for containers/feeder, 4-5 days bagged cement, 10-12 days bagged sugar. 10 vessels loading at berth of which 3 essential services, 7 containers. Discharging at berth 4 bagged sugar, 7 containers, 1 bagged cement, 1 bulk cement, 1 bagged fertiliser, 2 general cargo, 1 lpg. 8 containers (feeders) waiting at anchorage to load. 2 vessels Waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 1 bagged sugar, 1 bagged cement (receivers not ready). 5 vessels bunkering. 1 under repairs. 5 in drydock. 2 in drydock awaiting berth. 6 other vessels. 2 crew change. Labour shortage continues. Berthing delays on breakbulk vessels continue. Galle - one bulk cement clinker discharging at Berth. Trincomalee - one vessel discharging bulk cement clinker at Berth. 1 vessel loading bagged wheat flour at berth.
THAILAND, May 29 - Bangkok 76 vessels in port of which 6 containers, 70 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 6 vessels waiting at outer anchorage. 1-2 days berthing delay expected.
